results.finalMessage:
The workbench (`e_bench1`) was on the `editor` layer. `MainCamera` only renders `default` and `props`, so the culling mask was dropping it.

I set `MeshRenderer.layer` on the workbench to `default`, and I didn't touch the camera. I haven't confirmed it renders in game. The change is in `levels/outpost.scene` (transaction `tx_pj58585d`).

`ara_why` also flagged a low-likelihood issue: `meshes/bench.glb` may be missing next to its sidecar file. If the bench is still invisible, check that file first. You may need `git lfs pull`.
